description.value: Buckerfield's is BC's original country store, founded in 1919 and now operating ten locations across the province, with the Duncan store also serving as the company's head office. The large-format store carries farm and livestock supplies, pet products, garden centre items, wild bird feed, and outdoor clothing — a useful one-stop rural retailer on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor. The store is wheelchair-friendly, pet-friendly, and publicly accessible with free parking.
